limits: Admission facts are partial source observations, not independent review, live portal access or admission eligibility.
No blanket NTU English rule, inferred new TOEFL equivalency, universal work preference, undergraduate conversion or automatic subsidy.
Recurring month/day dates and old fee cohorts are not silently shifted to a future year.
NIE sixteen specialisations and English/Chinese pathways have separate source-bound requirements.
